text:
Ethan R.: Heads-up 12: ACME follow-up: they want a 4-week technical POC with firm EU+UK residency and explicit KMS control. We need to lock hosting recommendation and a short commercial table by EOD. Who can weigh in on tradeoffs?

Priya M.: Quick context: buyer wants minimal friction but legal may push for Dedicated or Private because of corporate policy. They asked whether Hosted can provide customer-managed keys and region isolation.

Connor L.: Tech notes from presales: baseline traffic ~100 req/s, expect short spikes to ~400 req/s during peak test scenarios. SLAs for POC: p95 latency target <400ms in EU zone, error rate <1%, and consistent model version pinned. They also want request-level audit logs kept for 60 days during the POC.

LegalBot: From legal: KMS requirement is negotiable for Hosted if we offer a DPA + documented key separation plan. Private (VPC) or Dedicated with BYOK are preferred for enterprise customers but we can propose Hosted as short-term with mitigations.

Ethan R.: Commercial ask from ACME: show delta for a 4-week POC vs upgrading to Dedicated for pilot month. Also need an approximate setup ETA for each mode.

InfraBot: Quick back-of-envelope estimates for POC length 4 weeks:
```
- Hosted: provisioning <24h, cost est ~$6,000 (token + usage)
- Dedicated: provisioning 2-4 business days if GPUs in pool, est ~$22,000 (includes small reserved pool)
- Private (VPC/on-prem): provisioning 3-5 weeks with PS + infra, est ~$60,000 (license + PS)
```
These are preliminary; will confirm after capacity check.

Priya M.: Proposed success criteria for the POC we can share with ACME:
```
1) Accuracy: >= 92% pass rate on buyer QA rubric across core intent prompts
2) Latency: p95 < 400ms EU for single-turn generation
3) Throughput: sustain 100 req/s for 20 minutes without errors
4) Reliability: <1% 5xx during test window
5) Compliance: all SSQ "must" items answered and controls demonstrably in place
```
Eval plan: 3 buckets (happy-path, edge-paraphrase, safety/abuse probes). Run automated metrics + 300 human evals sampled across buckets.

Connor L.: Notes on hosting tradeoffs in thread wording we can send to ACME:
- Hosted: fastest to start, lowest operational lift, can route all EU traffic to EU region, can pin model. Limitation: by-default we hold keys unless we enable BYOK in Dedicated/Private.
- Dedicated: isolation and predictable throughput; supports customer-managed KMS (BYOK) in many cases; provisioning time bump.
- Private: full control (VPC or on-prem), best for strict policy or regulatory needs, highest cost and longest lead time.
Also recommend we include a fallback strategy in the runbook: if p95 slips, automatically scale out with larger nodes or fallback to a lower-latency model variant and document impact.

Ethan R.: Buyer leans to "quick win first" but legal will have final say. Recommendation: offer Hosted with EU routing + a DPA + conditional BYOK option (Dedicated) as the next step. Include Private as an escalated path if legal mandates. Can someone draft a concise table (cost, lead time, security controls) for ACME?

Priya M.: I can draft the table and a 1-page runbook summary. Will include required SSQ items and pointer to our SOC2/pentest artifacts.

Connor L.: I'll prepare the capacity check and confirm dedicated lead time tomorrow. Also will prepare the eval harness and the 300-sample human eval plan.

LegalBot: I'll prepare language for the DPA + notes on BYOK capabilities and required legal steps for Private. Expect a draft by Thursday.

Ethan R.: Action items:
- Priya: one-pager + cost/lead-time table for Hosted / Dedicated / Private 12 due Wed EOD
- Connor: confirm Dedicated capacity and finalize eval harness + sample set (300) 12 due Tue
- LegalBot: DPA + BYOK wording and escalation path 12 due Thu
- InfraBot: finalize cost numbers after capacity check 12 due Tue

Priya M.: Also propose we include a short test plan: week 1 - onboarding + smoke tests; weeks 2-3 - traffic & eval; week 4 - hardening + security verification and handoff doc. That maps to their 4-week ask.

Connor L.: Agreed. Also suggest we spell out rollback & incident steps: e.g., enable autoscale, switch to dedicated or smaller model, and notify ACME with timeline.

Ethan R.: Great. If everyone delivers on owners we can send to ACME on Friday and get a legal green flag early next week. Thanks team :rocket:
